ns2:course.label: Introduction to DGS Honors
ns2:course.description: An introduction to the DGS James Scholars honor program. Classroom activities develop collaborative relationships between students themselves and the section facilitators. The small class environment offers additional opportunities for academic and social engagement, for mentoring, and participation in co-curricular events. The class will also present the breadth of diverse fields of study available and prepare freshmen to explore myriad potential careers. Students will engage in collaboration through campus orientation, study, and project based assignments. Credit is not given for both GS 102 and GS 101. Class Sched
